policy: Findings that CE-00.2 hands to an owning lot. The frozen CE-00.1 records are not edited here; each owner decides the scope change with review.

findings.title: font-display has no registry entry
findings.evidence: W-MOCKUP-1559 has one @font-face font-display declaration; its accounting is registry entry null with reason font-face-descriptor-not-in-inventory. The registry carries src and unicode-range but no other font-face descriptor.
findings.handoff: CE-09.1 defines the font-face resource schema. It decides whether font-face descriptors (font-display and the descriptor forms of font-family, font-weight and font-style) join the registry as system-resource entries, through a reviewed CE-00.1 scope change.

findings.title: Alpha 1 emits a raw selector key
findings.evidence: CE-NEG-UNKNOWN-SELECTOR-03 compiles without diagnostics under the built Alpha 1 compiler and the emitted stylesheet contains `[dir=rtl] &` verbatim (tests/core-evolution/run-negatives.mjs).
findings.handoff: CE-07.1 closes raw-selector authority gaps: a consumer key that is not a declared condition must be rejected. Until then the rtl profile has no negative fixture that Alpha 1 actually rejects; the rejection stays intended and is not counted as met.

findings.title: Invalid CSS values in measured consumer data
findings.evidence: W-UTIL-343 contains `direction: incoming` and `direction: outgoing`, which are not valid direction values (a variant property emitted as CSS). The Alpha 1 measurement counts them as absent-property gaps because it never checks value grammar (CAL-02).
findings.handoff: Kept as measured data. They imply neither validity nor fidelity and need no vocabulary. The CE-14 migration accounts for them as consumer defects, not as required coverage.
